description.value: Mucho Burrito is a Canadian fast-casual Mexican chain serving burritos, bowls, quesadillas, and tacos at the Belmont Market shopping area in Langford. The Victoria location offers online ordering and a loyalty rewards program. It sits in a suburban strip-mall plaza near the Trans-Canada Highway corridor.

address.value: Unit 102-3016 Merchant Way, Victoria, BC V9B 0X1
